posts.title: Saturday Word: Ripeness
posts.description: Ripeness , n. The state of being ripe (in various senses); maturity, mellowness. Shakespeare : What, in ill thoughts again? Men must endure Their going hence even as their coming hither. Ripeness is all. Come on.
